relationships.subject: AM1241
relationships.evidence_quote: AM1241 could enhance the threshold of PWL after day 4 with chronic morphine treatment, which suggested that AM1241 attenuates morphine tolerance.

relationships.subject: AM1241
relationships.evidence_quote: AM1241 treatment decreased the mRNA and protein expression of iNOS

relationships.subject: AM1241
relationships.evidence_quote: AM1241 treatment increased the level of IL-4 mRNA after morphine treatment in microglia

relationships.subject: AM1241
relationships.evidence_quote: AM1241 had a suppressive effect on the morphine induced expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines such as IL-1β, IL-6 and TNF-α

relationships.subject: IL-4 inhibitor
relationships.evidence_quote: IL-4I reversed the effect of AM1241 on p-STAT6 protein expression

relationships.subject: microglia M1 polarization
relationships.evidence_quote: The polarization of microglia in the direction of M1 caused morphine tolerance

key_findings: CB2R agonist AM1241 attenuated morphine tolerance in mice, an effect reversed by CB2R antagonist AM630 but not CB1R antagonist AM281.
AM1241 shifted microglia from M1 (iNOS) to M2 (SOCS3) and increased IL-4 and p-STAT6; IL-4 inhibition reversed these effects.
